label: Причём
description: A 10-sentence usage card for причём (moreover; and what's more).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Adding an emphatic detail. 'Причём' links a clause that adds a striking extra fact, here that the car was expensive. It introduces an afterthought that intensifies the main statement and sits at the head of the added phrase.

Strategic focus: Reinforcing with a qualifier. 'Причём' attaches 'отлично' as an upgrade to the claim that she speaks French. It carries the sense of 'and what's more', strengthening the point in casual and neutral speech alike.

Strategic focus: Emphatic addition with intensifier. 'Причём' opens a short tag that piles on 'очень', amplifying that the work is hard. This compact pattern is common in spoken Russian for driving a point home.

missions.phrase: Я опоздал, причём не по своей вине.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Adding an exonerating clause. 'Причём' introduces a clarifying detail that I was late through no fault of mine. It connects two ideas where the second qualifies and excuses the first.
Strategic focus: Highlighting manner. 'Причём' adds 'быстро' to underline how impressively the task was solved. The word frames the follow-up as a noteworthy bonus to the main achievement.

Strategic focus: Stacking two problems. 'Причём' joins a second drawback to the first, that tickets are expensive and also scarce. It signals that the added clause compounds the situation already described.

missions.phrase: Он пришёл поздно, причём без подарка.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Listing a further fault. 'Причём' tags on 'без подарка' as an extra grievance after being late. The construction is conversational and slightly indignant in tone.
Strategic focus: Adding a positive bonus. 'Причём' presents 'короткая' as a welcome extra virtue of the book. It works equally well for favourable and unfavourable additions, depending on context.
Strategic focus: Emphasising an unexpected repeat. 'Причём' introduces 'дважды', sharpening the surprise of meeting by chance. The added detail makes the coincidence feel remarkable.

missions.phrase: Он знает три языка, причём свободно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Crowning a claim. 'Причём' attaches 'свободно' to elevate the statement that he knows three languages. It signals the final, most impressive piece of information in the sentence.
